business_summary: MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited manufacture and sells industrial coatings in China and internationally. It serves wind turbine blades, shipping containers, wind power, bridges, and steel structures, shipbuilding, photovoltaics, marine engineering, energy storage, power generation, data centers, and other sectors. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Mega Coatings Company Limited and changed its name to MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited in 2020. MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited was founded in 2002 and is based in Shanghai, China. MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited is a subsidiary of One Faith Industrial Limited.
business_summary_ko: MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited는 중국 및 국제적으로 산업용 코팅을 제조 및 판매합니다. 풍력 터빈 블레이드, 선적 컨테이너, 풍력, 교량, 철 구조물, 조선, 태양광 발전, 해양 공학, 에너지 저장, 발전, 데이터 센터 및 기타 부문에 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Shanghai Mega Coatings Company Limited로 알려졌으며 2020년에 MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited는 2002년에 설립되었으며 중국 상하이에 본사를 두고 있습니다. MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited는 One Faith Industrial Limited의 자회사입니다.
